But JSON schema doesn't define arrays; still must populate those fields. Likely they expect single entries corresponding to VAT group. So set Net.Amount = 55.91, Vat.Rate = 20.00, Vat.Amount = 11.18.

- Net 55.91 + Vat 11.18 = 67.09 Brutto (matches). Skonto reduces payment to 64.41 (67.09 - 2.68 = 64.41). Good.
